intro: Klannoc Macleod is a rugged human warrior residing on Fray Island, situated off the eastern shores of the Barrens. Renowned as an arbiter of martial prowess, he tests aspiring brawlers from both the Alliance and the Horde who seek to master combat stances. Those who earn his respect are directed further inland toward greater trials of strength.

p: Isolated on Fray Island off the coast of the Merchant Coast in the Barrens, Klannoc Macleod oversees a brutal proving ground for seasoned fighters. Despite being human, Klannoc stands apart from the typical political squabbles of the Alliance and Horde, judging contenders solely by their grit, blade work, and resolve under fire.

Warriors directed to Fray Island are subjected to Macleod's trial: the Affray. Contenders step onto a raised iron grating to endure relentless waves of eager brawlers while Klannoc watches. Those who withstand the onslaught and defeat his chosen champion earn his seal of approval, proving they possess the temperament necessary for berserker training.
